description: This file contains utility validation functions for form fields in a Dart/Flutter project, providing static methods for common validation tasks such as required fields, positive amounts, email format, and minimum length for passwords.

classes.name: Validators
classes.description: A class providing static validation methods for form input fields.

methods.name: requiredField
methods.description: Validates that the input string is not null or empty, returning an error message if validation fails.

methods.name: positiveAmount
methods.description: Checks that the input string represents a positive numerical amount.

methods.name: email
methods.description: Validates that the input string is in a basic email format.

methods.name: minLength
methods.description: Ensures that the input string meets a minimum length requirement.
